content.short: Formo provides forms and product analytics for onchain builders.
content.description: Formo is a blockchain analytics platform that equips product and marketing teams with on-chain data insights. It helps teams understand and leverage on-chain activity to engage active users in web3, reducing time spent on analytics and accelerating product development. From early adopters to a mature product, Formo combines token-gated forms, wallet intelligence, and on-chain product analytics to drive growth and retention across networks.
content.meta: Formo is a blockchain analytics platform for web3 teams. Discover Formo and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
